title: SHELIKI 3-in-1 Robot Vacuum and Mop (D60S MAX, Self-Emptying Base)

comparisons.notes: Listed as D60S MAX with self-emptying base (70 days), 6000Pa, LiDAR, 220 min; same black SHELIKI robot and dock as the Woot photo; variant shows available

writeup: The SHELIKI D60S MAX robot vacuum and mop with a self-emptying base is $99.99 at Woot. It uses LiDAR mapping, offers up to 6000Pa of suction and runs up to 220 minutes per charge, and the base holds about 70 days of debris. MAMNV's store sells the same black kit for $389.99. Quantity is low, with a limit of 3 per customer.
